sources.title: Whole Life-Cycle Carbon Assessments guidance
sources.verified_claim: City Hall's WLC guidance explains how relevant proposals calculate and reduce carbon from materials, construction, use, demolition and disposal under London Plan Policy SI2; assessment requirements do not establish sample-parcel viability.

sources.title: Circular Economy Statement Guidance
sources.verified_claim: City Hall's Circular Economy guidance prioritises retention, adaptability, reuse and recycling and applies formally to the largest Mayor-referable developments while encouraging wider use; guidance is not planning consent.

sources.title: MD2962 London Plan Guidance – Whole life carbon and circular economy
sources.verified_claim: MD2962 records formal adoption of the Whole Life-Cycle Carbon and Circular Economy London Plan Guidance documents; adoption establishes guidance status, not parcel-specific compliance or outcome.

sources.title: Sustainable Transport, Walking and Cycling guidance
sources.verified_claim: The adopted guidance supports London Plan Policies T1-T3 and requires planning to protect and enhance land for walking, cycling and public transport capacity; it does not confirm capacity for a sample parcel.

sources.title: MD3021 London Plan Guidance
sources.verified_claim: MD3021 records adoption approval for Sustainable Transport, Walking and Cycling guidance and links it to transport capacity, safeguarding and Healthy Streets policies; formal guidance does not create a site permission.

sources.title: Chapter 10 Transport
sources.verified_claim: London Plan Chapter 10 requires relevant development to plan safe, clean and efficient freight, deliveries and servicing and states Construction Logistics Plans and Delivery and Servicing Plans should follow TfL guidance; such requirements are implementation controls, not delivery proof.

sources.title: Pride of Enfield Fund launched to support community-led improvements
sources.verified_claim: Enfield launched a £400,000 capital grant programme for community facilities, parks, high streets and green improvements with an application deadline of 9 March 2026 and completion deadline of 31 December 2026; the application window has passed and no sample-parcel award is inferred.

sources.title: Neighbourhood planning
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth explains neighbourhood planning as a community-led route to shape local development and notes one made neighbourhood plan in South Bank and Waterloo; neighbourhood-plan status must be spatially matched and is not automatically applicable to the sample parcel.
